_comment: T-0576 anti-case-lock.sh data-baseline (D-064 §5 full denylist). NOT code — a plain flat object of literal-key -> recorded code-only count (src/**/*.ts + web/src/**/*.{jsx,tsx}, excluding __tests__/.test.*, excluding comment lines; methodology mirrors detel-literal-baseline.sh). Semantics: 'erodes, does not grow' -- anti-case-lock.sh FAILs only when a count exceeds (not: differs from) its recorded value here. Any future task that reduces one of these counts is expected to ALSO lower the matching value here in its own diff (visible in code review, same transparency principle as frozen-sanctions.jsonl append-only). Recorded on T-0576's own HEAD (afa856b + this task's additions produce zero net new violations -- this task is CI-infrastructure only, it adds no case-specific literal beyond this baseline's own denylist keys, which are legitimate meta-strings, not hardcodes). T-0596 [W2/замок-харден] RECOUNT (review R-4 harden): the matcher became quote-agnostic (double/single/backtick, was double-quote-only) -- it now sees 5 real pre-existing single-quoted code occurrences in web/src/ that the old matcher was blind to (role-approver in screen-inbox.jsx:835; approvalRequired x4 in gateway-condition-panel.jsx:55/87/90 and screen-dmn-editor.jsx:47). These numbers are FACTUAL, measured by running the recounted ci/checks/anti-case-lock.sh production scan on this branch's own HEAD (task/T-0596-lock-harden, base dev@0370cf5) -- not transcribed from the T-0576 review's textual estimate. role-approver and approvalRequired are the only two keys that changed; the other six planes are unaffected (no single-quoted pre-existing occurrences of those literals exist today). T-0643 [анти-кейс/BUG-017 remainder] RECOUNT: 'soglasovanie' eroded 2->1 (aggregate 24->18) -- src/http/form-record-persister.ts's resolveApprovalFormRegistrySlug() used to carry its OWN duplicate literal fallback ('soglasovanie') despite its own comment claiming it read 'the SAME config-primitive' as step-applier.ts; it now calls step-applier.ts's resolveDefaultStepResultSlug() directly instead of re-declaring the string. The one remaining occurrence (step-applier.ts's SOGLASOVANIE_SLUG / the config-primitive's own default value) is architecturally required for ТЭЛ backward-compat (same reasoning detel-literal-baseline.sh already documents for 'tel-approval' staying at its floor of 1) -- lowering it further would change default-fallback behavior for tenants that never set an explicit process_app_binding.target_registry_slug, which is out of this task's scope (T-0643 also added a PUBLISH-TIME gate, process-defs.ts buildUnresolvedTargetRegistryViolations, so an unresolved target is now caught early instead of only at first-approve -- see ADR/spec T-0643). T-0616 [F-2, D-064 анти-кейс fix] RECOUNT: 'telLinear' eroded 3->1 (aggregate 18->16) -- src/core/process-catalog-view.ts's fallbackDefinitionName() no longer special-cases the literal key 'telLinear' to the case-literal display string 'Канонический линейный ТЭЛ' (review T-0614 F-2: an unknown/malformed proc_key defaulting through DEFAULT_PROC_KEY='telLinear' displayed as a CONCRETE named real process, a micro-case-hardcode); it now echoes EVERY key back honestly, telLinear included. src/http/process-projection.ts's DEFAULT_PROC_KEY const also changed its VALUE from the case-literal 'telLinear' to the neutral synthetic 'process:unknown' (not itself a denylist literal). The one remaining 'telLinear' code occurrence is web/src/forms/FormBuilder.jsx:509's placeholder="telLinear" example hint (UI copy, out of this task's scope) -- unchanged from before.
